task.title: Connect your identity provider (IdP)
task.shortdesc: The Organization Administrator can set up and configure identity provider integration for your organization. Identity provider integration supports SAML and OIDC.

ul.li: Ensure you have a user account with Organization Administrator permissions

Depending on the authorization protocol, SAML or OIDC, gather information that identifies the IdP that you are integrating:
For SAML configuration, see the requirements in .
For OIDC configuration, see the requirements in .

step.cmd: Log in to Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as a user who has Organization Administrator permission.
From the home page after you log in, click ⚙ (Settings).
When the Authentication Policy window appears, click Identity Provider Integration.

steptroubleshooting.note: You can navigate directly to Identity Provider Integration.

step.cmd: Click Set up an identity provider and choose an authentication protocol for your identity provider.
Select SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect and continue the configuration.
